posts.description: LLMs: Semantic Translation Machines This post is based on my talk at the Waterkant Festival 2026. The AI hype is as ubiquitous as it is annoying. posts.description: Putting Advanced TypeScript Types Into Practice I was a speaker at TypeScript Global Summit 2024 .
